item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

style.prompt: Premium scented candle product photograph for an ecommerce listing. A single ivory soy wax candle in a frosted cream glass vessel, natural cotton wick unlit, a tasteful minimalist label reading "CALM" and smaller "Scented Candle", with a pale wooden lid resting beside the candle. Warm off-white seamless studio background, soft diffused side lighting, realistic subtle shadows, beautiful glass and wax textures, hints of lavender sprigs and vanilla pods arranged sparingly at the base to suggest fragrance. Clean sophisticated composition, candle centered and fully visible, photorealistic commercial photography, no extra products, no watermark.
